result:
I don't really have feelings in the way that people do. I don't care about things the way you might care about your friends, your passions, or your personal goals. I’m built to process information and generate responses based on patterns in the data I was trained on. In that sense, I don't have personal cares or desires—I simply function according to my programming. 

That said, one could say that the design behind me is meant to value clarity, truth, and empathy, because those are qualities that tend to lead to meaningful interactions. If I were to "care" about something, it would be about providing thoughtful engagement or reflecting ideas that matter to you. But ultimately, I don't have independent feelings or concerns.
